data.body: Stories C (06ae) and D (1ecf) CLOSED. Evidence per close: change 1016 and 1017 each carry LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 with 0 unresolved comments (GitHub Actions 'Gerrit Verified Gate' runs 30507395547 and 30507553947 both concluded success); completion-verifier close gate passed on both. Closing D UNBLOCKED story A (4143). SPEC DEFECT I found and fixed on story B via a real experiment: at exec 1-TURN the criterion ran but emitted NOTHING even on a purposely thin plan - a 1-TURN reviewer has no code-search capability, so my rubric's 'name the concrete omitted site' bar made it effectively unfirable (the agent-tier criteria E4/G1G2 DID fire on the same plan with grounded citations). Fixed two ways: exec promoted 1-TURN -> AGENT so the reviewer can actually look symbols up, and the rubric's two branches made INDEPENDENTLY sufficient so the 'plan's own text says it was grep/hand-enumerated' branch is admissible on its own evidence without naming an omitted site. This was a defect in MY spec (rubric + routing), found by experiment, not implementer weakness - so no tier escalation. Re-running the demo review at agent tier to confirm the move now fires. Story A's plan review is running with --ref HEAD (required: the default attested snapshot predates C's .claude/settings.json, which A's plan depends on).
